title: Art. 5.5.1 — Annex 11 - Air Traffic Services, Chapter 5 - Alerting Service, 5.5 Information to the operator, 5.5.1
content:
When an area control or a flight information centre decides that an aircraft is in the uncertainty or the alert phase, it shall, when practicable, advise the operator prior to notifying the rescue coordination centre.

Note. If an aircraft is in the distress phase, the rescue coordination centre has to be notified immediately in accordance with 5.2.1.
